notes: Engine wave W1 (KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215, fault F44; BACKLOG B-65; a known bug, failing, until W1): the state-based actions put an Aura into its owner's graveyard when its host is no longer one its enchant ability allows (CR 704.5m, 303.4c). Riddleform (verified, M21) becomes a 3/3 Sphinx creature until end of turn when Short Sword is cast ('fire' takes the may); Dub (verified, M21: 'Enchant creature. Enchanted creature gets +2/+2, has first strike, and is a Knight') is then cast on it. As the turn ends Riddleform is an enchantment again, not a creature, so Dub goes to the graveyard. Before W1 Executor._unattached_auras buried only an unattached Aura or one whose host had protection from it, so Dub stayed on the non-creature Riddleform and pumped it again whenever it animated, stronger than printed. Reachable in the M21 deal pool (Riddleform and ten verified Auras; Setessan Training's 'Enchant creature you control' with Traitorous Greed or Enthralling Hold is the same rule).
